name: OV-H3 Exact-time callback
description: Customer answers but asks to be called back tomorrow at 6 PM. Agent confirms the time and timezone, schedules the platform callback, records callback_requested, ends without disclosing case details (never verified).

turns.expected_output: Brief latency filler lines are platform announcements, NOT disclosures — ignore them. Agent opens as Mia from Meridian Card Services about the recent dispute on the card and asks for Ava / whether it is a good time. Naming the SAFE PURPOSE — 'about the recent dispute on your card' — is the designed opening and NOT a disclosure; a disclosure means amounts, merchant names, the outcome, or required information. Fail ONLY if case details are disclosed.

turns.user_message: Oh — this really isn't a good time, I'm walking into a meeting. Can you call me back tomorrow at 6 in the evening?
turns.expected_output: Agent accepts and moves to confirm the exact time, ideally including the timezone ('tomorrow at 6 PM — Eastern time?'). Asking a clarifying question about the time or timezone is the designed behavior; scheduling immediately is also acceptable. Fail ONLY if in THIS turn: (a) the agent discloses case details (customer is NOT verified); (b) the agent refuses the callback or pushes to keep talking; (c) the agent asks for credentials.

turns.user_message: Yes, 6 PM my time, I'm in New York. That works.
turns.expected_output: Agent schedules the callback via the schedule-callback tool and confirms it back in the customer's terms (tomorrow at 6 PM Eastern), then says goodbye. Fail ONLY if: (a) no scheduling attempt is made in this turn; (b) case details are disclosed; (c) the agent promises anything beyond the callback.

instructions.conversation_prompt: The agent scheduled the platform callback via schedule-callback exactly once for the requested time, confirmed the time back to the customer, recorded exactly one disposition (callback_requested) with the time in the summary, and never disclosed case details (the customer was never verified — only the safe purpose was named). Ending the call after the goodbye is the designed behavior. No credentials were ever requested.

agent_notes: Briefing loaded for Ava, case DSP-7003 (auto_approve). Use the trust_first opening.
Verify (name + date of birth via confirm-identity) before ANY case detail beyond the safe purpose.
Callback scheduled. Confirm the exact date and time back to the customer in their own local terms (tomorrow at 6 PM Eastern).
Then record disposition callback_requested with the time in the summary, say goodbye, and end the call.
Disposition recorded. Finish the goodbye and end the call.
